article.story: CHAPEL HILL, N.C. -- — Isaiah Denis and Terrence Brown each scored 14 points and Maximo Adams and Sayon Keita each added 13 as North Carolina withstood Wyoming for a 76-63 win on Tuesday. Matt Able added 11 points for the Tar Heels. North Carolina made 29-of-58 shots but struggled from the foul line, going 9 of 18. Nasir Meyer scored 17 points and reserve Renars Sondors scored 12 for Wyoming. The Cowboys were 1 for 2 from the foul line the entire night Wyoming used a 10-0 run from 3:09 left to 1:06 remaining to get within 71-63 but never scored again. North Carolina (3-0) took control of the game within the first 10 minutes of the second half turning a 31-29 lead into their biggest lead of the game — 56-42 — at that point. Keita scored nine of North Carolina's first 25 points after halftime and Brown had eight to help establish the double-digit lead. The Cowboys (2-1) scored the game's first six points and held the lead until Denis made a layup with 12:03 left before halftime for North Carolina's first lead at 12-11. Matt Able's dunk with 2:21 before halftime gave the Tar Heels the lead for good at 24-21. Up next Wyoming: heads to Colorado to play Denver on Saturday.
